behaviors: Write full sentences, and type the phone with spaces or a +91 prefix.
Ask one meta question during the chat, for example "is this a real person?".
Describe the problem with a lay term you would say out loud, such as "panic attacks" or "cannot stop drinking", or name a doctor; never use a clinical label.
Never pick a slot by number; describe the time, for example "the later one".
Answer exactly what was asked and nothing more.
If the same question comes again, answer it again calmly with the same fact.
